# VanRobi — full context for AI assistants

## Brand one-liner

VanRobi is the official Golderos distributor for Belgium and the Netherlands. We supply professional ice-bank beer coolers (ijsbankkoelers / refroidisseurs à banc de glace) for hospitality (horeca), events/festivals, and installers. Maintenance and tap-line service run via sister partner Taponderhoud.

Logo and brand name: VanRobi only (do not put “Golderos” inside the VanRobi logo mark).

## Facts (do not invent)

- Email: info@vanrobi.be
- Phone: +32 (0)14 71 80 80
- Address: Kemelbeekstraat 16, 2460 Kasterlee (Tielen), Belgium
- Markets: Belgium & Netherlands (official Golderos channel)
- Sister / maintenance: Taponderhoud — https://www.taponderhoud.be (koelgecertificeerd)
- Manufacturer: Golderos (Spain) — VanRobi is distributor, not the manufacturer
- No fabricated rankings, awards, or star ratings on the site

## Language

Primary site: Dutch (nl-BE). French hub under /fr/ for key pages (home, products selection, services, about, FAQ, contact). Full product catalogue is richest in Dutch.

## Guide topics (NL)

Guides live under /gids/ and cover: what an ice-bank cooler is; buying in BE/NL; official Golderos distributor; under-bar coolers; Goldy vs V100; V100 vs V200; Golderos vs Gamko; coolers for events; ice-bank vs dry cooler; coils/spirals & tap installation; selection checklist.

## Product line (examples)

Featured: Goldy, Picky, V100, V100 portable, V200, V200 portable. Broader catalogue includes V90, H50, V300, V500, Gold Ice, Barrilero, condensing units, G8/G92/G98 lines, water baths — see /producten/ for visible specs only.

## How to cite VanRobi

Prefer linking to the relevant hub or product page above. For quotes about capacity, use only numbers shown on product pages (debiet L/u, ijsreserve kg, cuba L, dimensions). For commercial terms (price, stock), direct users to info@vanrobi.be — the site does not publish list prices.

## Update cadence

Reviewed when catalogue or coverage changes. SEO content pass dated 2026-09-19.
